files.sources/lookup.md:
# Lookup

The lookup screen searches saved item names. An empty result says No matching items. The lookup_label(name) helper returns Search followed by the item name.

steps.prompt: Document the lookup behavior in docs/lookup.md, add a comment explaining lookup_label in src/labels.py, and add a lookup_hint string to src/messages.json. Keep existing behavior and the empty-result message unchanged.

grader_files.checks/check_lookup.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,runpy
assert runpy.run_path("src/labels.py")["lookup_label"]("Tea")=="Search Tea"
assert json.loads(Path("src/messages.json").read_text())["lookup_empty"]=="No matching items."
import ast,io,tokenize
text=Path("src/labels.py").read_text()
fn=next(n for n in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="lookup_label")
assert ast.get_docstring(fn) or any(t.type==tokenize.COMMENT for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(text).readline))
